edit.description: PlatformPreemptAttempt gains the ending it records
the preempt fold, which must not merge several into one cause

summary: a preempt records the agent process's exit code, or on posix the signal that ended it, and each preempt keeps its own ending rather than several folding into one cause
acceptance: every preempt record carries the real exit code or signal — never a placeholder — and a wave with two preempts reports two endings
tests: a preempt records the agent process's exit code
a preempt records the signal that ended the agent process
two preempts in one wave each record their own ending rather than one shared cause
notes: `PlatformPreemptAttempt` (src/Prompt.ts:290) carries only `failureClass` today. A pattern a reader draws from several preempts ending together is not a verdict the engine records.
